description: Data for: Dynamic modelling and techno-economic analysis of adiabatic compressed air energy storage for emergency back-up power in supporting microgrid is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Shihong Miao. Including dynamic modelling process of piston compressors, radial turbines, air storage tank, tube and shell type of heat exchanger, water tank, synchronous machine and microgrid components. Simulation parameters of adiabatic compressed air energy storage and microgrid are listed in the document. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2020. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is Public Domain Dedication. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
